construction.base: R44AS critical block with shared pivot x and five nonpivot variables per block
construction.backbone: For every adjacent block pair and every corresponding nonpivot variable v, add the two binary clauses encoding v_i <-> v_{i+1}.
construction.effect: Both post-split siblings remain connected; repeating one local satisfying model across all blocks satisfies the backbone.

rank_theorem.critical_extension_lemma: Adding a clause whose variables are already in a maxdef-critical formula preserves maxdef-criticality and raises delta* by exactly 1.
rank_theorem.child_argument: Adding c clauses raises maxdef by at most c; the full child formula has deficiency k+c because the backbone adds no variables, so equality holds.

transport_theorem.forward_existence: Apply the R44BP signed permutation independently in each block. The equality-backbone is invariant because simultaneous sign changes/permutations map each equality relation to another equality relation already present in the backbone.
transport_theorem.support_lower_bound: Every signed transport in either direction has support at least k. If an entire target block is pointwise fixed, local target clauses remain local. Cross-block backbone clauses cannot subsume a purely local image, and other source blocks use disjoint local variables, forcing the forbidden identity local transport on that block.
transport_theorem.connectedness: Each local sibling incidence graph is connected and equality edges join corresponding variables across adjacent blocks, so each global sibling incidence graph is connected.
transport_theorem.conclusion: The transport exists, both siblings are connected and nonterminal for growing k, but required support grows unboundedly.

theorem_effect.does_not_refute: Polynomial discovery exploiting structured unbounded support, or broader substitution/model-transport classes.

next_exact_question: Can one discover the unbounded but highly structured block transport in polynomial time without bounded-support enumeration, and what invariant recognizes that factorized/global symmetry while the siblings remain connected?
